facts.fact: 火车上，Captain Ambrose 身子前倾，直视 Mrs Fell 的双眼讲述这件事
facts.anchor: On the train, Captain Ambrose leaned forward and looked Mrs Fell directly in the eyes

facts.fact: Captain Ambrose 把那位客人带进 Scrooge 的房间
facts.anchor: I brought the client inside and carried him through to Mr Scrooge’s room

facts.fact: 他们脱下客人的大衣、给他喝水，一两分钟后他缓了过来
facts.anchor: We took off his greatcoat and gave him some water to drink and a minute or so later the fellow came around
His name, he said, was Halvorsen

facts.fact: Halvorsen 生于瑞典，以水手身份来到英格兰
facts.anchor: He had been born in Sweden and had come to England as a sailor

facts.fact: 他说将近三年没有上船了
facts.anchor: He had not been on a ship, he said, for almost three years now

facts.fact: 船长把这种缠身称作可以随身携带的纠缠
那影子从暮色降临一直跟到黎明微光
facts.anchor: There was someone beside him from the moment that twilight began to descend until the first glimmerings of the dawn

facts.fact: 那影子是个与他同龄的小个子男人，瘦削结实，衣衫褴褛
facts.anchor: a small man of about his own age, very lean and sinewy and dressed in rags

facts.fact: Halvorsen 坚称那不是活人，而是死后不肯离开人世的东西
facts.anchor: The spectre was no living man but something which had died and refused to leave the world

facts.fact: 只有在教堂围墙之内他才得以喘息
facts.anchor: The only place where he had a respite in the hours of darkness from this persistent thing was within the walls of a church

facts.fact: Scrooge 说被人纠缠总有原因
这些说法源自他亲身经历的过去
facts.anchor: how they are born of his own experience

facts.fact: 他们说服 Halvorsen 一起吃了点午饭
facts.anchor: We spoke some more and persuaded Halvorsen to take a little luncheon with us

facts.fact: 三个人一起等到夜晚降临
facts.anchor: And then we waited, the three of us, for the arrival of the night
